blurb: Hello. I’m Dave Molnar, owner and operator of Custom Tours on Lake Winnipesaukee. Have you always wanted to see the big lake from the water? Our motto “cruise without the crowd” means you can do exactly what you want with the people you want. I personally design each cruise to ensure that you get the best lake experience. Shallows, shopping, bars and restaurants, ice cream, sunsets or just a cruise around the lake,
